text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.28. The strongest evidence for the Java Software Engineer role is their experience with API development, specifically that they "Built REST APIs" and have a background in "Spring Boot". Key gaps include a lack of experience in CI/CD, monitoring, API gateway, and containerisation, as well as having only 1.54 years of experience. The application was escalated for further review despite the missing must-have requirements and low overall fit.
